describe.description: The image shows a single quadrupedal animal in right-facing lateral view against a plain off-white background, standing with its body low to the ground and its back arched. The animal has an elongated head tapering to a blunt snout, a stout trunk, four thick limbs ending in large curved claws, and a long tapering tail extending behind the hind limbs to the right. Most of the dorsal surface, the top of the head, the outer sides of the limbs, and the tail are covered in overlapping dark brown to gray scales with lighter tan edges and fine striations. This scaly covering is interrupted by several large, irregular, pale pink, wrinkled, hairless patches of exposed skin on the mid-back, the mid-flank above the forelimb, and the lower rear/upper hind limb area. The ventral underbelly and lower limb skin is pale cream to pinkish with a wrinkled texture. The animal is standing on all four feet, with claws in contact with the ground and small dark speckles suggesting dirt on the lower legs and feet.

describe.description: A stocky quadrupedal mammal shown in right-side profile walking on four short legs. It has an elongated tapered head with a pointed snout and small dark nose, a small dark eye, and a rounded external ear. Its back, sides, top of the head, and top of the long thick tapering tail are covered in overlapping dark brown to gray keratinous scales, with large irregular areas of pale pink hairless bare skin exposed on the upper back and mid and rear sides. Its underside and parts of the legs are pale grayish-tan skin with sparse scales. Each foot is a broad paw bearing long curved dark claws, and the tail extends back along the ground to a point.
